behavior_constraints: mean aggregation computes a trimmed mean (drop highest and lowest) when 4 or more matching runs exist; otherwise computes regular arithmetic mean
export step with format csv outputs a header line 'index,value' followed by newline and 'index,value' lines per element
annotation keys are normalized to lowercase on add, delete, and read; duplicate-key check is case-insensitive; regex validation still applies to original key
model version creation deduplicates and alphabetically sorts tags; empty/nil tags remain empty
GET /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/diff?v1=&v2= returns metric_diff (with null for missing sides), stage_diff, tags_diff; 400 on missing/invalid/equal params, 404 on missing model/version
GET /api/v1/serving/models/{name}/health returns healthy/stale/orphaned status with loaded_version, loaded_stage, registry_stage, stage_match; 404 if not loaded

GET /api/v1/experiments/{name}/correlation?metrics=x,y returns Pearson r rounded to 4 decimals and count of runs with both metrics; 400 if fewer than 2 runs, missing/invalid metrics param, or zero std dev yields r=0; 404 if experiment missing
POST /api/v1/pipelines/history/record stores execution result with sequential id and RFC3339 recorded_at; 400 if pipeline_name empty
GET /api/v1/pipelines/history?limit= returns most recent N records with total and returned counts
POST /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/{num}/rollback resets stage to development, clears lineage, resets demoted_by to 0, preserves annotations; 404 if model/version missing
affected_prior: AggregateMetric (mean aggregation behavior in experiment tracker)
ExecuteExport (csv output format in pipeline steps)
AddAnnotation, DeleteAnnotation, ListAnnotations, AnnotationsMap, validateAnnotationKey (case sensitivity in registry)
LoadModel (must record registry stage at load time for health check)
entities.summary: This round changes trimmed-mean aggregation, CSV export headers, case-insensitive annotation keys, and deduplicated/sorted version tags, while adding endpoints for version diff, serving health checks, metric correlation, pipeline execution history, and version rollback.

instruction_head:
